Y no podrías respirar: allá hay 95,1 % CO₂, 2,59 % nitrógeno, 1,94 % argón, 0,16 % oxígeno.

story_en.explorador: With the data we have, Amazonía – torre K34 (Reserva Cuieiras) is not very similar to Mars in any measure. It is not alike in plants. But the air is very different: the pressure there is less than 1% of the pressure here. On Mars you would weigh only 38 parts out of 100 of what you weigh here. And you could not breathe: the air there is 95.1% CO₂, 2.59% nitrogen, 1.94% argon and only 0.16% oxygen.
